### ① Derived judgments
- Diff is exactly 2 files, +2/-2, one commit `0cb1dd9c` on `origin/main` (`git diff --stat origin/main...FETCH_HEAD`; PR file list +1/-1 each). No published schema, no code, no changeset: no accepted-set change. Correct.
- SKILL.md L94 old: 「内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写,唯一例外 `rerun_failed_jobs`(限 CI 红单次重跑,先核 head)」; new: 「内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写;CI 红单次重跑亦经中继 `rerun-failed.mjs`,先核 head」. Every other rule on the line survives with unchanged meaning: REST-proxy-only content writes, no MCP writes, the re-run is the CI-red one, single (单次), head checked first. The MCP exception is gone. Correct.
- The relay naming is right: `scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs` L4-6 ("re-run the FAILED jobs of one `ci.yml` pull-request run, ONCE, as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, through the fleet-write relay's `run_rerun_failed` op"), RELAY-ONLY section L48-52 ("there is no direct path"); `ops.mjs` L205 names `run_rerun_failed` as the second `actions: write` row, with the ONCE fence L223-224 and the HEAD fence L226-233 (run's `head_sha` must be the pull's CURRENT head) backing 「单次」 and 「先核 head」. Correct.
- platform-readings.md L286 old: 「`rerun_failed_jobs` 复用原 run 的提交与合并 ref,不拿新 main 重算」; new: 「中继重跑(`rerun-failed.mjs` → `run_rerun_failed`)复用原 run 的提交与合并 ref,不拿新 main 重算」. The fact is kept verbatim; the op name matches `ops.mjs` L205-210 (POST `rerun-failed-jobs` starts a new ATTEMPT of the completed run, passed jobs carried over) and the already-present neighbours L288-289 that name `rerun-failed.mjs` / `run_rerun_failed`. Correct.
- `git grep -n rerun_failed_jobs FETCH_HEAD -- .claude/ AGENTS.md` is empty (exit 1); on `origin/main` it still hits SKILL.md:94 and platform-readings.md:286 only, so the premise holds and nothing else grants the MCP re-run. `git grep -iE 'rerun|re-run|重跑' ... | grep -i mcp` at head leaves only SKILL.md:94 (the new line) and platform-readings.md:120.
- platform-readings.md:120 「读数:`POST /actions/runs/{id}/rerun-failed-jobs` REST 回 403 而 MCP 回 201」 sits in the two-channel envelope readings block (L118-124, each line a 「读数」/⇒ inference) and states a measured response, not a permission; AGENTS.md L413 ("Every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/`") and SKILL.md L94 govern. Agree with the dev: a recorded reading, not a grant; leaving it is right and not widening is right. execution-duties.md:133 is a ⛔ prohibition list of MCP writes, consistent.
- Line budget: SKILL.md 319 → 319 lines at head (ceiling `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md', 319]` at `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L413, identical on `origin/main`; headroom 0 unchanged, no ceiling raise). platform-readings.md 458 → 458. Line-width rule (ratchet header L193-201, ≤120 bytes): SKILL.md L94 is 111 bytes (was 118), platform-readings L286 is 119 bytes (was 84). Both under the cap.
- PR body (read via `gh api pulls/30715`): `Fixes #30159` present; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derived as right for a text-only `.claude/**` diff (no accepted-set or metadata-key change); labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset`.
- `skip-changeset` is right: AGENTS.md L1020-1021 reserves the label for "a diff that publishes nothing from any released package"; `.claude/**` is not a released package. `Check Changeset` check-run is success.
- Head check-runs (`commits/0cb1dd9c…/check-runs`, 45 runs): all completed, every conclusion success or skipped as of 2026-11-05T23:12Z; none red, none pending. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Type Check · *` all success. PR is still `draft: true` (expected before this record on a Tier S path).
- Branch merge-base `4bf9a2d7` is behind `origin/main` `badf24df`, but `git diff FETCH_HEAD origin/main` on the two hit files and the three cited scripts shows only the PR's own 2/2 lines, so the base drift is irrelevant to this change.

### ② Semver level
None: `.claude/**`-only prose, publishes nothing; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` all consistent with that.

### ③ Boundary flags
- Dev report 6671797404: `deviations: "none"` (the card-thread branch `claude/project-thread-9lt17l` instead of a worktree-named branch is platform-designated and matches the claim comment 6671495910), `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`. The one out-of-scope note (platform-readings.md L120 is a reading, not a grant) is answered above: agreed, no action.
- File surface held to the dispatch order (`/mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat1/dispatch-30159.md`: SKILL.md L94 only, platform-readings.md L286 only): yes, the diff touches exactly those two lines.
- PR author `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay author to name.

### ④ Design judgment
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (L94): holds against the code it cites. The invariant now says what the tooling enforces: `rerun-failed.mjs` is RELAY-ONLY (header L48-52, direct route = exit 3 with zero writes), the relay mints `actions: write` for that stroke alone (`ops.mjs` L205, L236-240), and the ONCE and HEAD fences (`ops.mjs` L223-233) are what 「单次」 and 「先核 head」 point at. The acceptance scenario (no MCP write exception; the one CI-red re-run goes through the relay with head checked first; paid within the ceiling) is met on the same line. No must-fix, no should-fix.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (L286): holds. The merge-ref fact is unchanged and now attributed to the relay re-run by the same two names the following lines L288-289 already use, so the block reads consistently. At 119 bytes the line is one byte under the ratchet's 120-byte cap; acceptable, noted only so a later edit on this line wraps rather than grows. No must-fix, no should-fix.
